_comment: Hand-observed per-spell facts that NO database carries. db.exil.es has no immunity data and no reagent field, so nothing here can be derived and nothing should be guessed. Keyed by spell id; ability names are for the reader.
_why: Most bosses are stun-immune, so a stun that says it 'interrupts non-player spellcasting' may do nothing on the target that matters. Some stuns DO land. Whether a given boss resists silence is likewise unknown. Only testing settles it, and an untested row must read as unknown rather than as a guess.
_values: Omit a field entirely while it is untested -- blank renders as unknown, never as 'no'.
_workflow: Add or edit an entry, then re-run `python3 tools/utility_tables.py > notes/raid-utility.md`. Both columns are regenerated from here, so hand-editing the markdown is lost and editing this file is not.
_fields: boss: yes | no | partial  -- does it work on a raid boss? Most bosses are stun-immune, some stuns still land, silence immunity is unknown. || reagent: the item consumed, or 'none' if confirmed to need nothing. Battle rezzes are the usual case.
